title: Attalus of Macedon
summary: Raleigh names Attalus of Macedon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Attalus, who with Parmenio transported Philips Armie into Asia, and whose Neece Cleopatra Philip married. He is not Attalus nephew of Daedalus. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
